text_block_list.text:
To let Espoir City rest since she wasn't 
feeling well, I brought her to the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I told you I don't need anyone looking 
after me! I'm going to sleep! Just leave 
me alone!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, huh? Where am I...?

text_block_list.name: Radio Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Breaking news! We have received reports 
of a 50-meter Chihuahua currently 
rampaging through downtown!"

text_block_list.name: Giant Chihuahua
text_block_list.text: Yip!! Yipyip!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa~~!!?? What's your deal, pal?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: S-Stop right there, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text:
S-She stopped a giant Chihuahua in its 
tracks--!! Incrediiible~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Wai— Haaaah?! My hand moved on its 
own, but what was with that strength just 
now?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, Espo-n is a super strong Umamusume, 
right? In your grip, even a crazy hard 
iron ball would—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"It's gotten all squishy like clay... 
Hey... You've gotta be kidding me, hey..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"It's the natural outcome. Right now, 
Espo-san is truly... 'the strongest in the 
world.'"

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text:
ES-PO!! The strongest!! ES-PO!! The 
strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-What the... Am I seriously getting 
stronger...?

text_block_list.name: Radio Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Breaking news! We have received reports 
that a massive UFO fleet from outer space 
is approaching Earth to capture Espoir 
City...!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? What is it this time...mini!?

text_block_list.name: Alien Statement
text_block_list.text:
"Her immense power will be the key to 
conquering the universe. As we conquer the 
stars, we shall properly 'manage' and 
'utilize' her."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hmm. The greater the power, the 
heavier the burden you have to carry, huh?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"The alien forces seem both numerous and 
formidable. What is the plan, Espo-san?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tch...! I don't really get it, but you 
sure know how to piss me off...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"‘Management’? ‘Effective utilization’? 
You messing with me, huh, bastard?!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
My strength doesn't belong to anyone 
else!! Run your mouth at me again and—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'll make every last one of you see 
stars!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Kh! ...Just a dream, huh...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. If you're gonna show me something, 
at least show it till the very end.
